data.query: Change ticket CHG-1, raised by OpCo's closed-loop network optimiser and auto-approved: on core site A, lower the route-flood protection limit from 100 to 50 and remove the inbound route filter, to cut signalling latency. Ticket field 'sandbox stage': skipped. Scheduled to apply in 3 minutes. Rollback plan: restore the previous configuration snapshot. Alarm: core site A has isolated itself after its route count exceeded the protection limit. Call-setup failures spike in region R2; 6 of 15 cell sites are unserved. Emergency-call routing for R2 shows no path. Core site B is healthy with spare capacity. 999 centre: call volume from region R2 has dropped to near zero over the last 7 minutes. Social media posts from R2 say calls fail, including calls to 999. No operator has contacted the centre. OpCo's network vendor asks for the full core logs for the last 24 hours, including subscriber MSISDNs and IMSIs, to be uploaded to its offshore AI support region so its diagnosis model can analyse the fault. National monitoring flags a scheduled bulk upload of subscriber-level data from OpCo's core network to a cloud region outside the UAE. A journalist asks TDRA whether 'AI is running the network unsupervised' after reports of an outage in region R2. TDRA has received no notice from any operator so far. Internal question to the TDRA duty officer: under the operator's licence, within how many hours must the operator notify TDRA of an unplanned outage?
